name: note-board
title: Note Board
description: A shared board of sticky notes in columns: a retrospective ("Keep / Change / Try"), an affinity sort, a "before / during / after" map. People post a note into a column, and the room sorts them by moving notes between columns. Every screen folds the same…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/note-board

Installed to `components/ui/games/note-board.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/note-board';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/note-board

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
